debit.notes: Customer care shown as "Call CUB's 24 X 7 Customer Care" with the Call Us popup labelling the lines "Domestic 18001205000" (customer-care page: "18001205000 - All States") and "International 044 7122 5000"; the bank's WhatsApp banking contact is +91 44 7122 5000 (site widget links api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=914471225000). Verified block path (debit page, verbatim): "Now you can choose to block or activate your Debit card through CUB Net, CUB Mobile banking for transactions Online or at ATM and PoS"; the page links the CUB mobile banking apps Android com.cub.plus.gui and iOS id1054779617. No SMS block keyword/short code is published (the bank's pages list official SMS headers CUBANK-T/S/P and CUBLTD-T/S/P only as a fraud caution). Migration: existing internet & mobile banking is discontinued from 30-Oct-2026 — new net banking https://online.cub.bank.in/ and new app "CUB New All in One" (no store link for the new app is published on the pages fetched). The website navigation also carries a call button dialing 18009997788, and the bank's transaction-monitoring number is 1600118005 — "Always attend calls from these numbers". Report unauthorized transactions: https://ccm.cub.bank.in/portal/en/home. 1930 is not mentioned on the bank's pages.

credit.notes: Credit-card FAQ "What should I do if I lose my Credit Card?" (Dhi CUB Visa Signature Credit Card page): "on your notifying us we will immediately to block your credit card from being further misused" and "Customers may also block their credit card through their mobile/ internet banking application"; "You can conveniently manage your Dhi CUB Visa Signature Credit Card through Net Banking or Mobile Banking App". Credit-card customer care 1800-309-1442 handles lost/stolen/damaged card replacement ("Card replacement charges of Rs 500+ taxes are applicable") and statement disputes; disputes may also be emailed to creditcard@cityunionbank.in (general customer care: customercare@cityunionbank.in). Bank-wide contact lines (site Call Us popup / customer-care page): "Domestic 18001205000" ("18001205000 - All States") and "International 044 7122 5000"; WhatsApp banking contact +91 44 7122 5000. No SMS block keyword/short code is published. Migration: existing internet & mobile banking is discontinued from 30-Oct-2026 — new net banking https://online.cub.bank.in/; new app "CUB New All in One" (no store link for the new app is published on the pages fetched). Report unauthorized transactions: https://ccm.cub.bank.in/portal/en/home. 1930 is not mentioned on the bank's pages.
